sql: SELECT CAST(T1.num_students * T1.pct_female_students AS REAL) / 100 FROM university_year AS T1 INNER JOIN university AS T2 ON T1.university_id = T2.id WHERE T1.year = 2011 AND T2.university_name = 'Stanford University'

SELECT T1.num_students - CAST(T1.num_students * T1.pct_female_students AS REAL) / 100 FROM university_year AS T1 INNER JOIN university AS T2 ON T1.university_id = T2.id WHERE T1.year = 2011 AND T2.university_name = 'Emory University'

SELECT T1.country_name, CAST(T3.num_students * T3.pct_female_students AS REAL) / 100 FROM country AS T1 INNER JOIN university AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.country_id INNER JOIN university_year AS T3 ON T2.id = T3.university_id WHERE T3.year = 2011 AND T3.university_id = 23

SELECT DISTINCT T1.university_name FROM university AS T1 INNER JOIN university_ranking_year AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.university_id WHERE T2.year = 2015 AND T2.score < (SELECT AVG(score) * 0.28 FROM university_ranking_year WHERE year = 2015)
